query:
SELECT SPLIT_PART(payload->'value'->>'source', '#', 1) AS "asset_id!",
               COUNT(*)::INT AS "c!",
               COALESCE(SUM((payload->'value'->>'object')::NUMERIC), 0)::TEXT AS "volume!"
        FROM mn.instructions
        WHERE kind = 'Transfer' AND payload->>'variant' = 'Asset'
        GROUP BY 1
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1
